audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level-chart rows contradicted their own why text and the packet chart. The worst was Level 6: win[4]/phases[4].side said Lillia while whys[4] says her R dashes on and Twilight Shroud eats your targeted sleep. Level 2+ items said Akali while whys[6] says you reclaim it.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Lillia/Lillia/Skill/Skill/Akali/Akali/Lillia and every why line agrees with it; the stored sides did not.
audit.corrected: Both layers moved to the packet chart in matched pairs, ratings set to 7/5/3 by owner, and all seven full-layer why lines rewritten (they were generic boilerplate copied from another matchup — 'the lane is a treadmill he can't get off' is false into Akali).

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer sold Level 6 and first item as Lillia spikes; they are Akali's.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is a two-part dash with an execute on 120/90/60s, and Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, so your Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1, 1600 range) can be blanked. Her first AP item converts that into a one-shot.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why now state Akali's spikes by name; phases[6].why keeps your genuine 2+ item reclaim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shuriken Flip was never named in the full layer, and the Twilight Shroud downtime was stated as fifteen seconds.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s, not 15s. Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and is the dash that flips a level 3-5 trade. NOTE: Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable, so a targeted cast into it is wasted — that is why the sleep needs Dream Dust on her first.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and Shuriken Flip inserted into phases[2].why, phases[3].why and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0), and the one number given was wrong.
audit.why: The whole matchup is 'commit only on Shroud downtime', and that downtime is twenty seconds at rank 1.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now says step up hard for the next twenty seconds; phases[2].why keys the level-3 caution to Shuriken Flip's 16s.

audit.why: 28.57% over 14 games — far too small a sample to lean on; nothing written depends on it.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Akali is melee with no Twilight Shroud yet — Q-sweetspot from range and start Dream Dust for free.

edits.before: W sweetspot threat starts — anyone chasing you eats the big hit while your Dream Dust burns their HP bar.
edits.after: A Shroud-less Akali cannot close through your stacking Q speed and the Swirlseed slow — chip her energy.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-kite in circles, E from fog for the slow, and the passive speed makes every trade yours to end.
edits.after: Full Q poke still grinds her, but Shuriken Flip at 16s starts letting her contest if you misposition.

edits.before: The lane is a treadmill he can't get off — Q every step-up, kite the Twilight Shroud window, and bank Dream Dust burn.
edits.after: You out-poke a pre-6 Akali, but one Shuriken Flip gap-close flips a trade — it is a knife-edge window on every step-up.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: At 6 Perfect Execution dashes onto you and Twilight Shroud eats your targeted sleep — she executes first.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Her Rocketbelt or Stormsurge spike turns Shroud-into-R into a one-shot before Dream Dust ticks her down.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Your Liandry's percent-HP burn and roam tempo reclaim it once her assassin window passes.

edits.before: Akali burns Twilight Shroud on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Akali burns Twilight Shroud on nothing — step up hard for the next twenty seconds.
